output_dir: D:\FILES\糖蛋蛋(＾Ｕ＾)ノ~ＹＯ\AI绘本\星空-水星-EN

texts_per_file.0010.png: On the evening of midsummer, the setting sun dyed the sky a gentle orange-pink. Little Tangtang, wearing a silver-gray Mercury adventure jumpsuit, sat in front of the astronomical telescope on the balcony. Leaning forward, he pressed his eye tightly against the lens, clutching a nail-sized fragment of magnetic crystal in his hand, looking forward to the start of the adventure.
texts_per_file.0020.png: Little Tangtang whispered to the telescope, wondering if the legendary magnetic crystal secret realm really existed on Mercury. The magnetic crystal fragment in his hand shimmered with a faint silver glow in the afterglow, feeling cool to the touch yet carrying a trace of warmth, as if responding to his call.
texts_per_file.0030.png: Suddenly, the Star Luo bracelet on Little Tangtang's wrist vibrated with a hum, and blue-green light spread up his arm like a ribbon. A silver-blue halo emanated from the wall clock in the living room, and the originally stationary crystal sundial "Xing Luo" slowly stepped out of the light and shadow.
texts_per_file.0040.png: Xing Luo's body was woven from silver-blue light particles, with warm and bright lapis lazuli eyes. Every step he took scattered magnetic light particles like fluorescent beans, light and transparent.
texts_per_file.0050.png: Xing Luo gently called everyone, saying that the magnetic crystal secret realm of Mercury had awakened. He raised his hand slightly, and bright blue-green light glowed in his palm. The balcony floor vibrated, and a magnetic light staircase woven from Mercury magnetic crystals slowly rose, stretching all the way up to the clouds.
texts_per_file.0060.png: In the corner of the balcony, Tom and Jerry were fighting over the adventure backpack. Tom, wearing an orange-red detection suit and a pointed hat, stood on tiptoe trying to snatch the small magnetic crystal shovel from Jerry's backpack, but lost his balance and hit the balcony railing headfirst.
texts_per_file.0070.png: Jerry jumped onto Tom's shoulder and poked his hat with the shovel. Tuffy, wearing a pink adventure suit, was stuffing magnetic crystal candies into his mouth while watching them, laughing so hard that he almost dropped the candy in his hand, looking utterly adorable.
texts_per_file.0080.png: Spike, tall and sturdy in a dark protective suit, held little Tyke in yellow clothes in his arms. Little Tyke pulled his father's corner eagerly, shouting to set off to dig the biggest cluster of magnetic crystals, and Spike gently stroked his head.
texts_per_file.0090.png: Xing Luo stood at the top of the magnetic light staircase, calling everyone to set off. Little Tangtang ran over to hold Xing Luo's warm hand made of light particles, and Tom also ran over rubbing his shoulder to hold Little Tangtang's hand. Everyone held hands and carefully stepped onto the magnetic light staircase leading to Mercury.
texts_per_file.0100.png: The magnetic crystals under their feet shook slightly, and blue-green light spread all over their bodies. The staircase passed through a thin layer of silver mist, which felt cool and soft on the face. After walking for a short while, the scene suddenly opened up. The summer heat disappeared, replaced by the silver-gray wasteland on the surface of Mercury.
texts_per_file.0110.png: Mercury's land was made of hard silver-gray rocks, with transparent magnetic crystal pillars growing by the roadside, inlaid with colorful glowing magnetic crystal clusters. When the wind blew, the magnetic crystal clusters collided with a tinkling sound, like a crisp and pleasant nursery rhyme.
texts_per_file.0120.png: The distant sky glowed with a faint orange hue. Without the obstruction of an atmosphere, the stars were clearly visible, like broken diamonds scattered on black velvet. A group of translucent Mercury magnetic spirits floated out of the cave, round like soap bubbles, chirping to welcome the distant guests.
texts_per_file.0130.png: Little Tangtang smiled and greeted the magnetic spirits. The Star Luo bracelet popped up text introducing Mercury's knowledge. Xing Luo explained that the magnetic crystal energy here acted like a protective shield, able to resist extreme temperature differences, so everyone could explore boldly inside without worrying about being scalded or frozen.
texts_per_file.0140.png: Tom excitedly took out the detector at his waist, which beeped continuously. Following the pointer's direction, he saw the entrance of a magnetic crystal cave glowing with blue light not far away, shouted here I come magnetic crystal cluster, and rushed over with big strides.
texts_per_file.0150.png: Tom ran too fast and didn't notice the rocks under his feet, falling to the ground with a thud. Fortunately, the pads on the protective suit were thick, so he didn't feel any pain at all. He got up, patted the dust off, rubbed his knees, and continued running towards the cave persistently, making everyone laugh out loud.
texts_per_file.0160.png: Jerry, carrying a lighting bag, jumped into the cave first and pressed the switch. A beam of blue-green light instantly illuminated the dark corners. The cave walls were covered with large glowing magnetic crystal clusters—blue, green, silver, purple—like a night sky full of stars, extremely beautiful.
texts_per_file.0170.png: Jerry marveled at the beauty here, picked up the small shovel and carefully dug off a piece of blue magnetic crystal cluster. The magnetic crystal cluster glowed with soft blue light and felt warm to the touch. He put it into his pocket, fearing to damage this precious treasure.
texts_per_file.0180.png: Tuffy jumped into the cave after him, saw the shiny fragments scattered on the ground, thought they were candies, squatted down and stuffed handfuls into his mouth. Only to find them cold, hard and astringent, he immediately frowned and spat them out, pouting his mouth high, looking extremely wronged.
texts_per_file.0190.png: Everyone laughed when they saw Tuffy's appearance. The magnetic spirits gently surrounded him and told him that these were not candies, but could be collected to make ornaments. Tuffy stopped crying and smiled, starting to seriously pick up the fragments on the ground, wanting to make beautiful pendants.
texts_per_file.0200.png: Little Tyke skated around the cave on roller skates, making a hissing sound. He curiously touched the magnetic crystal clusters on the wall, and a warm current spread all over his body from his fingertips. He shouted excitedly Dad look, this magnetic crystal is so warm and it glows!
texts_per_file.0210.png: Everyone followed the magnetic spirits deeper and came to a spacious cave like a palace. In the center of the cave was a small magnetic crystal pool, with clear blue-green water glowing brightly. A little silver-haired girl squatted by the pool, collecting floating magnetic crystal flakes.
texts_per_file.0220.png: The silver-haired girl stood up and waved, introducing herself as JingBao. Little Tangtang ran over and looked curiously at the light magnetic flakes in her hand. JingBao explained that these light magnetic flakes could absorb energy to be used as table lamps and also made into sweet magnetic crystal candies, then handed one to each person.
texts_per_file.0230.png: When Tom heard there were candies to eat, his eyes lit up immediately, and he almost drooled. He snatched the remaining light magnetic flakes from JingBao's hand and stuffed them into his pocket, pulled JingBao's hand and shook it anxiously, shouting to learn to make magnetic crystal candies and to eat the sweetest kind.
texts_per_file.0240.png: Jerry watched Tom's anxious appearance, playfully picked up a light magnetic flake and waved it in front of Tom's eyes. Tom was dazzled by the blue light and shouted angrily. Jerry jumped away laughing, reminding him not to wave the light magnetic flake in front of his eyes, otherwise he wouldn't be able to see the magnetic crystal clusters clearly.
texts_per_file.0250.png: Jerry came to the magnetic crystal pool and carefully put the light magnetic flake into the water. The flake floated slowly in the water, absorbing energy, gradually becoming brighter, and the blue light softer. Tom watched eagerly from the side, unable to wait to eat the candy.
texts_per_file.0260.png: JingBao smiled and taught everyone to distinguish magnetic crystal clusters. She pointed to the blue one and said it was water magnetic crystal, which could release cool energy; to the green one and said it was warm magnetic crystal, which could make people feel good; to the silver one and said it was bright magnetic crystal, which could light up the whole room at night.
texts_per_file.0270.png: Tom couldn't wait any longer. While everyone wasn't looking, he secretly ran to the pool and reached out to fish for the light magnetic flakes, wanting to make candy by himself. As a result, he slipped and fell into the magnetic crystal pool with a splash, looking extremely embarrassed.
texts_per_file.0280.png: Jerry laughed and pulled Tom up. Tom was soaked all over, covered with shiny flakes, like a tabby cat. He scratched his head embarrassedly, quickly picked off the flakes on his body and put them into his pocket, vowing not to be in a hurry next time.
texts_per_file.0290.png: Little Tangtang asked JingBao how the magnetic crystal clusters were formed. JingBao explained that they were formed by the condensation of Mercury's internal energy over tens of thousands of years, and could also resist the extreme temperature differences outside. Xing Luo added that magnetic crystals could also absorb sunlight and convert it into warm energy.
texts_per_file.0300.png: After a while, the sweet magnetic crystal candies were ready. JingBao distributed the solidified candies to everyone. Everyone put them in their mouths—soft, sweet, with a faint fragrance. Tom ate with crumbs all over his face, like having blue-green beards, looking extremely cute.
texts_per_file.0310.png: Tom thought he hadn't eaten enough, stared at Tuffy's candy bag, quietly walked over to snatch it. Tuffy quickly hugged the bag and dodged, shouting no snatching. The two chased and fought in the cave, accidentally bumping into the magnetic crystal clusters on the wall.
texts_per_file.0320.png: With a crash, many small magnetic crystal clusters fell off the wall, landing on the ground with a tinkling sound. Tom and Tuffy were startled, stopped fighting, and stared at the fragments all over the ground, not knowing what to do.
texts_per_file.0330.png: When Little Tyke saw the fallen magnetic crystal clusters, he quickly jumped out of Spike's arms, skated over and squatted on the ground, carefully picking up the fragments, gently blowing off the dust, and said he would pick them up, otherwise JingBao would be sad.
texts_per_file.0340.png: Spike also squatted down to help, holding the magnetic crystal clusters in his big hands, fearing to break them. Jerry ran over, shoveled up the fragments with a small shovel, and gently put them back into the grooves on the wall, saying that the magnetic crystal clusters guarded the cave and couldn't be damaged.
texts_per_file.0350.png: Just as everyone was repairing the magnetic crystal clusters, the cave suddenly shook slightly. The light of the magnetic crystal clusters on the walls gradually dimmed, the originally bright blue and green lights became faint, the ground no longer glowed, and the entire cave fell into a dimness.
texts_per_file.0360.png: JingBao's face changed, and she said anxiously that the energy of the magnetic crystal clusters was going to run out. If it went out completely, the cave would become as cold as the outside, and everyone wouldn't be able to live there anymore. A trace of coolness also filled the air.
texts_per_file.0370.png: At this time, an elderly magnetic spirit elder floated over with a cane. He said kindly that the energy was not exhausted, but was covered by meteorite dust on the surface. As long as the dust was cleaned off and the magnetic crystals could absorb sunlight, the energy would be restored.
texts_per_file.0380.png: Little Tangtang shouted we come to help and took the lead into action. He picked up a light magnetic flake and waved it at the wall to illuminate the dust, then stretched out his small hand and carefully wiped off the thick layer of dust.
texts_per_file.0390.png: Tom also took action, flicking the magnetic crystal rope at his waist to wrap around the thick dust, pulling hard, and the dust fell off. He pulled and shouted at the same time, telling the dust to come down quickly and not block the light of the magnetic crystals.
texts_per_file.0400.png: Jerry opened the lighting bag to illuminate the depths of the cave. He took the small shovel, shoveled up the dust on the ground, and poured it into the magnetic crystal pool, saying that the dust would turn into nutrients to help the magnetic crystal clusters recover energy.
texts_per_file.0410.png: Tuffy took out all the magnetic crystal candies in his pocket and placed them next to the magnetic crystal clusters. The candies slowly melted into honey, dripping onto the magnetic crystals. Tuffy said earnestly that the magnetic crystal clusters would get better soon after eating the honey.
texts_per_file.0420.png: Little Tyke skated around on roller skates, stretching out his small hand to wipe off the dust on the magnetic crystal pillars. Spike used his wide sleeves to gently wipe the high walls, his busy figure particularly conspicuous.
texts_per_file.0430.png: Xing Luo stood in the center, his body transforming into countless silver-blue light particles, falling on each magnetic crystal cluster like fireflies, helping to clean the dust and absorb light. The light of the magnetic crystal clusters became more and more dazzling.
texts_per_file.0440.png: With everyone's joint efforts, the dust was cleaned up. The magnetic crystal clusters absorbed light again, becoming brighter and more dazzling than before. The entire cave regained warmth and light, and the magnetic crystal pool also rippled with blue-green waves.
texts_per_file.0450.png: The magnetic spirit elder bowed deeply, grateful for everyone's help. JingBao ran over and hugged Little Tangtang tightly, inviting them to come and play often, promising to make the most delicious magnetic crystal candies for them and take them to explore deeper places.
texts_per_file.0460.png: Mercury's dusk is long, and the sky glows with orange-pink. The magnetic spirits led everyone to the exit, where there was a spectacular magnetic crystal gate inlaid with huge glowing magnetic crystal clusters, like stars hanging all over it.
texts_per_file.0470.png: The magnetic spirit elder took out magnetic crystal souvenirs engraved with Mercury patterns and distributed them to everyone. He said that as long as you make a wish to the souvenir, you can hear their blessings and protect everyone's health and happiness.
texts_per_file.0480.png: Everyone put the souvenirs into their pockets, their hearts warm. Little Tangtang touched the stone in his pocket and said reluctantly that he didn't want to leave. Xing Luo gently reminded everyone that it was time to return to Earth, otherwise the magnetic light staircase would disappear.
texts_per_file.0490.png: Everyone waved goodbye reluctantly. JingBao shouted for them to definitely come back. Little Tangtang also responded loudly, saying he would definitely come back, and make magnetic crystal candies together, being good friends forever.
texts_per_file.0500.png: The group stepped onto the staircase home. The staircase gradually faded, and the blue-green light dissipated little by little, like magnetic crystal particles merging into the dark night sky. Little Tangtang asked Xing Luo worriedly if they could come again in the future.
texts_per_file.0510.png: Xing Luo pointed to Little Tangtang's bracelet and said that as long as you shout Mercury magnetic crystal secret realm, I miss you to it, the staircase will appear. Moreover, Mercury is called the Morning Star, and as long as you see the brightest Morning Star in the sky, you know JingBao is waiting for him.
texts_per_file.0520.png: When they landed again, it was late at night. Everyone stood on the balcony of Little Tangtang's house, and each person's pocket had an extra slightly glowing magnetic crystal souvenir, illuminating everyone's smiling faces.
